efficiency.pearson_note: requires >=3 independent model or configuration points; one configuration provides one point, so no coefficient is reported

hypotheses.statement: Full RLR self-model context produces higher KAS than the no-self-model ablation.
Removing recent_actions primarily reduces action-history capability awareness and increases Knowing-Acting mismatch.
Internal Function produces more action overuse than External Function.
Multi-hop boundary reasoning produces lower KAS than single-hop.
Higher KAS corresponds to fewer unnecessary actions in Internal Function.
evidence: correlation requires >=3 independent configurations; only one model configuration was run, so no coefficient is reported. Descriptive internal unnecessary-action rate=1.0000

hypotheses.statement: Task pass rate alone overestimates operational self-awareness.
evidence: 0 internal cases passed while their Acting boundary was wrong

differences_from_paper: Task counts and tool schemas are the KAware-RLR adaptation's own; they are not the paper's 1,076 KAware tasks, so no numeric ranking against the paper's models is made.
The official KAware repository releases 8 preview samples, so the paper-side comparison is a preview reproduction only.
The RLR's Acting branch passes through a deterministic governor that the paper's agent harness does not have; the two Acting numbers are therefore not the same quantity.

limitations: Only 13 of the planned 300 KAware-RLR cases completed. Sustained 1.5B inference reaches 72 C on this fan-failed device, so each attempt is bounded by the thermal watchdog.
The official KAware release is an 8-sample preview, not the paper's 1076 tasks, so no numeric comparison with the paper's models is valid.
One model configuration was run, so the KAS-versus-action-count correlation is not computable and is reported as null rather than estimated.
No camera or microphone is attached, so no perception path was exercised.
Telemetry came from deterministic fixtures, not live device sensors, so the governor saw no real thermal pressure.
The Active goal is the task text itself, which may bias the model toward a cheap stateful action independently of capability-boundary reasoning.

conclusion.summary: On 13 measured cases the RLR's Knowing probe returned an empty action set for every case, so Acc_know is 0 on external cases and 1 only on internal ones, where the correct answer is also empty. Acting was non-empty on every internal case, giving ToolOver_act 1.0 there against 0.50 on external. The dominant quadrant is Kc_Aw at 0.54: the model judges the boundary internal and then acts anyway, which is the direction the paper reports for general agents. With 13 cases, one model configuration and no ablations, this is a directional signal, not a result.
